start: A gym member on a build with the coach switched on, 3 workouts this week, one lift beat its best on Tuesday

steps.action: Open the Coach tab, ask 'How is my week going?'
user_sees: An answer that uses today's workout and its Targets, kg lifted this week, recovery, and '1 lift beat a best this week'
must_not: Numbers that differ from Progress, the records list or the workout screen's Targets
A first-ever set counted as a record

user_sees: The strength score and an insight line (coach on only)
must_not: A made-up score when no records exist

start: A gym member on the store build (coach switched off), after finishing a workout

steps.action: Finish and save a workout, go to the Workout tab and Progress
user_sees: No insight line and no strength score anywhere
must_not: The insight line or strength score shown while the coach is off
A Home screen with numbers that never update

start: A gym member with the coach on whose weekly kg read fails once (database busy)

steps.action: Ask the coach for a snapshot
user_sees: The older (frozen) numbers stand in for the failed part
must_not: A crash or an empty answer
The stand-in kept as if fresh: the next read must try again

start: A gym member with the coach on, nothing saved since the last snapshot

steps.action: Ask the coach twice in a row
must_not: Different numbers with nothing saved in between

steps.action: Save a new workout that beats a best, ask again
user_sees: Kg lifted and 'lifts that beat a best this week' go up
must_not: The old numbers from before the save

user_sees: Today's workout and this week's numbers move to the new day

start: A gym member with the coach on and body weight logged

steps.action: Ask the coach an open question
user_sees: An answer about the member's training
must_not: The snapshot sent to the AI without the member having switched the coach on
Body weight sent when the member was told it never leaves the phone
